mechanism_note: Dispatch is a merit-order/LP over free and 'excess' (above stress_frac) blocks; cost is piecewise-constant in mu. Excess block price = fuel + mu*coef_g (coef=[0.0105,0.0208,0.0587] $/MWh per unit mu). For mu ~1e4 every excess block is above the spot import price (80-160, max 400) but below VOLL=5000, so units only overload to avoid shedding; this ordering holds until gen2's excess price crosses VOLL at mu ~8.5e4. Any state-dependent price that stays inside that window yields the same dispatch; leaving it trades wear for imports (low mu) or for shed load (high mu), both worse.
